question: A right triangle with sides 56 cm, 42 cm and 70 cm is rotated about the side of 56 cm to form a cone. The total surface area (in cm2 ) of the cone so formed is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **right triangle** is rotated about a side, that side becomes the **height (h)** and the other perpendicular side becomes the **radius (r)**.

Rotation about 56 cm side ⇒ **Height (h)** = 56 cm and **Radius (r)** = 42 cm.

**Slant height (l)** is the hypotenuse = 70 cm.

Total Surface Area = πr(l + r) = π × 42 × (70 + 42) = π × 42 × 112 = 4704π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 4704π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sides of right triangle = 56 cm, 42 cm, 70 cm. Rotated about the 56 cm side.

**Formula Used:** Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cone = πr² + πrl = πr(r + l)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d25b5c97ab07bc5715efe5d2b952d42156a946f2422926cc06c1092fd38fd8a9.png] 

⇒ **Radius (r)** of the cone = 42 cm

⇒ **Slant Height (l)** of the cone = 70 cm

⇒ **Total Surface Area** = π × 42 × (42 + 70)

⇒ **Total Surface Area** = π × 42 × 112

⇒ **Total Surface Area** = 4704π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4704π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The relationship between slant height (l), radius (r), and height (h) is given by l² = r² + h².

Curved Surface Area

The area of the curved surface of a cone is πrl, where r is the radius and l is the slant height.

Volume of Cone

The volume of a cone is (1/3)πr²h, which is exactly one-third of the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height.</p
